title: Mixed Event — Warmth in Every Stitch — Episode6 Precious Moments

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku feels grateful for all of Mafuyu's help with studying and club activities, and wants to do something in return. When she learns that Mafuyu is looking for ways to improve her home ec project, she offers some embroidery lessons.

rows.Line: Community Center

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Stick in the needle, pull down and...

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line:
Yes, very good.
Next, you need to get the needle back out.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: In, out... In, out...

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Grandma, look!
My bunny has a whisker now...!

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Look at that! And what a whisker it is.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I think I'll give this to Shii if it turns out okay.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Hehe. She loves rabbits, so I'm sure she'll love it.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: You think so? Then, I'm going to make the cutest bunny I can for her!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, my bunny's ears are slowly coming together...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Hehe. This pink thread's so cute...
I hope Shii likes what I'm making for her...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want to show her as soon as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, but I don't want it to get crooked. I need to go slow and steady...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: (So that Shii will smile and say that it's cute...)

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Grandma?

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: No, I just noticed how much you're smiling.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Are you enjoying embroidering?

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! Making the lines is fun, and my chest feels so warm for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: I see. Then, that means you and I are peas in a pod, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: We are...? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Really? The joy I'm feeling must be overflowing.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: After all, I treasure every minute that I spend embroidering.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: (She felt this same warmth...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm still getting used to this...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I think I really like spending time embroidering...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I remember Shii being so happy when I gave her the bunny handkerchief I made for her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After that, I fell even more in love with embroidery.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. That's such a beautiful story.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even now, I'm reminded of the things my grandmother told me whenever I'm embroidering something.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That the time you take and the thoughts you put into each stitch for someone are very precious things...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, that having people we care about enough to want to make gifts for them is such a blessing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I enjoy embroidering things for others so much, and treasure every minute of it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. I never thought about it like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but these are just my personal beliefs...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Some people simply enjoy crafting beautiful objects, while others enjoy the quiet time spent focusing. We're all allowed to enjoy embroidery however we like.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Including you, Asahina.
My hope is that you'll get to freely express yourself through embroidery.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
I'll try to discover what I enjoy the most about the activity.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to talk for so long.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I really appreciate you telling me that story about when you were little. Anyway, let's get back to work, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (We're all allowed to enjoy embroidery however we like...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I do sort of understand the appeal of working on something like this in peace...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And using my own two hands to make something is somewhat soothing...)
